meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo AI Video Materials
meta.description: Generate batches of short-video material clips without subtitles or voice-over for MoneyPrinterTurbo.
meta.inputSummary: Scene description, aspect ratio and scene index

steps.instruction: Generate a standalone video clip suitable for short-video editing. Do not generate subtitles, text, titles, watermarks, logos or voice-over audio. Keep subject motion and camera movement natural and avoid abrupt cuts.

instructions: Each row generates one independent MP4 video clip.
The scene index keeps multiple clips for the same subject visually distinct.

fields.label: Scene description
fields.description: The visuals, subject, action and camera requirements for the clip to generate

presentation.placeholder: e.g. An office worker in a modern office using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in

fields.label: Aspect ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio used by the final MoneyPrinterTurbo video

fields.label: Scene index
fields.description: The scene number within the batch, starting from 1

values.scenePrompt: An office worker in a modern office using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in, no text and no watermark
